content.short: Suberra helps businesses accept crypto payments anywhere for anything.
content.description: Crypto payments are typically push-based, requiring merchants to initiate each charge and creating friction for subscription-style billing. Suberra provides a pull-based payment layer that shifts the model toward recurring crypto payments, empowered by a single upfront authorization. After that consent is given, future charges can be collected automatically, with no additional user action required. This separation of authorization from settlement streamlines subscription workflows for merchants.
